answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the island queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The haven index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 355 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the violet. The fee repeats 14 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
